rv.q: Radiohead are a useful sauce to disguise something “good for the child,” the adaptation a decent gateway into Shakespeare, but no more than a chaotic experiment for those familiar with the Bard, alas.
However, while there were very many elements of this work we enjoyed, we didn't feel it came together as a particular coherent whole.

cn.t: This Radiohead-infused Hamlet receives a mixed reception, with critics praising the live band's powerful rock sound during intense moments but questioning the overall execution of merging Shakespeare with the 2003 album.
